title: Paul's Farewell Address to the Elders from Ephesus
description: In Miletus, Paul calls the elders of the congregation from Ephesus to him. He reminds them of his service among them, tells that he is bound by the Spirit and going to Jerusalem where chains await, and warns against ravenous wolves who will come into the flock. He commits them to God and the word of His grace, and they take a tearful farewell at the ship.
